theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+2.29%) and Technology (+0.77%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-2.11%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.66%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.73%, defensives -1.30%, and value/cyclicals -0.26% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.52%, Dow -1.22%, Nasdaq -0.24% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.29%. The VIX rose 2.15% to 19.45, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.50% to $4,010.00, crude oil was little changed at $103.44, and bitcoin slipped 0.55% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
